title: 1T Views Music Disc (Revival)
description:
It is a Custom Disc in Minecraft Java Edition,
and this is a revival of my 4 year ago resource back in curseforge.
body:
This is a Resource Pack that replaces C418 - Far,
with 1 Trillion views song

that is imported to Minecraft itself

Preview:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/d8oeayC3vGU" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

and yes, I already tested every version of MC possible with every version of 1 trillion music disc resource pack

thanks to Itsme64's resource pack converter, that I can convert to any version in the same resource pack

Original Track:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/CRvbXDeGmZM" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

BTS:
- The logo was made in Photopea.
- the song is downloaded using ytmp3.ai and converted it to .ogg
- the versions 1.6.1 - 1.18.1 was made from scratch.
- the versions 1.19 - 1.20.6 and 1.21.2 - 26.1.2 was updated using itsme64's MC texture pack updater.
- the versions 1.21 - 1.21.1 was edited with a 1.21 template by Mojang on texture-packs.com.
- the versions 26.2 PR 1 - 26.2 (official release) was also edited with a 1.21 template.


q and a:

 
Q: can you make a new one?

A: only if they hit 2 trillion, ill make a new one.

 

Q: is this a data pack?

A: this is resource pack, sorry bud.

 

Q: do you still celebrate 1 trillion views of minecraft in youtube?

A: in 2026? no its 4 years already.
